name: CAMS-Knee (ETH Zurich and Charite Berlin, J Biomech 2017)

pairing.region: instrumented total knee replacements in living subjects
pairing.xray: fluoroscopic image series from a moving fluoroscope that follows the knee, at 25 Hz, registered to the implant components
pairing.ct: the implant components' CAD files, not a CT
pairing.pose: the tibial and femoral 4 x 4 poses at every fluoroscope capture, shipped
pairing.masks: none; the registered images carry the implant components
pairing.annotate: nothing for the spine; fluoroscopy of metal implants in living subjects during daily activities

what: 6 people with instrumented total knee replacements (Charite Berlin), measured at ETH Zurich in June 2014 during level walking, stair and ramp descent, sitting down and standing up, squats and standing: the joint loads the implants measured, a moving fluoroscope following the knee (pulsed at 25 Hz, 1000 x 1000 pixels at 12 bits, a 30.5 cm field) whose images come registered to the implant components, whole-body markers, force plates, 16-channel EMG and camera video (Taylor et al., J Biomech 2017;65:32-39, doi:10.1016/j.jbiomech.2017.09.022); the same form offers Stan (Dreyer et al., J Biomech 2022;141:111171), a reference subject made from these data, whose files are loads and kinematics alone, with no images, so it has no record of its own
licence: the CAMS-Knee licence agreement, which the requesting institution signs: non-commercial, scientific use without any commercial benefit, at the registered institute only, not passed on to third parties (as the data request page reads, read 2026-10-23)
how_to_get: Read the data request page https://cams-knee.orthoload.com/data/data-request/ and the agreement https://cams-knee.orthoload.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/4/CamsKnee_DataLicenseAgreement.pdf; the form asks for a name, an organisation, an email, a status, a project title and a description, takes the agreement and a project description as PDFs, and offers the fluoroscopic images and the implant CAD files as datasets of their own.

The owner decides on the terms, the agreement needs Wayne State's signature, and the form goes from the owner's hand with a project description worded as CONTRIBUTING.md says; an approved request is answered with a personal, time-limited download link, which never goes into a record or a manifest, so the owner fetches it on the grid as a Slurm job, never on the login node.

A sample, a video and its description for one subject's gait and squat trials, is on https://cams-knee.orthoload.com/data/data-download/ with no agreement; what else it holds is to confirm on the page.
record: the owner's list of fluoroscopy sets of 2026-10-23, checked against the Veriserum paper (arXiv:2509.05483), which names CAMS-Knee and Stan, and the CAMS-Knee pages read the same day
source_status: found by checking the owner's list of fluoroscopy sets of 2026-10-23; not requested; behind a form and the CAMS-Knee licence agreement, which the requesting institution signs, for scientific use without commercial benefit
